text:
elaine: kickoff: we need a concise handoff doc for the private-deploy upgrade orchestrator. goal: safe operator transitions for VPC/on-prem customers while preserving tenant IPs and custom BGP peering.
bobby: 👍 can we capture the three installer presets we discussed (airgap, compat-shim, greenfield-minimal) and map them to expected customer roles?
mina: +1. also include a short flow for customers that manage their own routing (customer-managed BGP) — we need explicit preflight checks for route acceptance and ASNs.
carlos: installer note: for onprem, MTU mismatches show up often. preflight should run an MTU probe and warn if < 1500. also verify node-local routes for hostNetwork pods.
elaine: good call. preflight checklist so far: KMS reachability, artifact verification (sha256), RBAC check for CRD ops, MTU probe, outbound egress to telemetry endpoints, kubelet version compat.
mina: for the orchestrator itself, require operator image pinned by digest and a compatibility matrix for CRD versions. operator must support dual-schema mode during handoff.
bobby: dual-schema mode: operator accepts v1beta1 and v1 CRDs simultaneously and migrates at resource reconciliation time. need a clear rollback if migration fails.
product-ops: launch criteria request: what must be true before we can mark this GA for Dedicated customers? propose: e2e + field runbook, two customer pilots (one airgap, one VPC), documented SLOs for upgrade latency and failure rates.
elaine: agree. also add a support SLA clause for manual rollback assistance during first 30 days post-upgrade.
carlos: how do we preserve tenant IPs? two patterns: 1) preserve Service IPs by keeping old ClusterIP annotations and patching services after operator update, 2) preserve external IPs by reapplying annotations against cloud LB. doc must enumerate both and show kubectl snippets.
bobby: include sample kubectl patch for service IP preservation: `kubectl patch svc mysvc -p '{"spec":{"clusterIP":"192.168.10.5"}}' --type=merge` and caveat about immutable fields on some CNI plugins.
mina: for customer-managed routing, add acceptance tests: verify route advertisements, confirm next-hop reachability, and run BGP session flapping simulation.
eliane: (typo) noted.
elaine: mina, can you own the routing acceptance test list?
mina: can do. target prototype tests in k8s-integration harness by next Tues.
ops-bot: NOTE: we should emit per-tenant rollout events to the control plane with fields: tenant_id, phase, operator_digest, trace_id. that'll help support correlation.
product-ops: also require a small post-upgrade validation checklist: smoke query, embedding production path test, cache warmup. customers should be able to opt into automatic cache warming.
carlos: packaging: add distro matrix (debian-11, debian-12, rhel-8, rhel-9) and an offline bundle format (tar.gz with signed manifest). include verification commands.
bobby: on rollback semantics: operator writes a short status CRD `UpgradeStatus` with reason codes. support teams can query `kubectl get upgrades -n redwood` and run `operatorctl rollback <upgrade-id>`. include example output.
mina: operator dry-run mode idea: `operatorctl plan --tenant=...` prints jsonlines of planned changes with resource diffs and a risk score. very helpful for field ops and customers.
elaine: add that to the playbook. also document an escalation path: who to page, what logs to collect, and how to produce the minimal repro for oncall.
product-ops: reminder: launch criteria must include a documented rollback window (default 72h) and a configurable policy per-customer. capture as config snippet in the manifest.
bobby: manifest snippet suggestion: `upgradePolicy:
  mode: staged
  canarySelector: "labels.upgrade=canary"
  ramps: ["1h:1%","6h:5%","12h:25%","48h:100%"]
  rollbackWindow: 72h`
carlos: add troubleshooting matrix for common network failures: DNS blocked -> run `dig @1.1.1.1`, MTU -> `tracepath`, NAT hairpin -> `curl --interface`. short and actionable.
mina: airgap nuance: some customers validate artifact signatures offline. include offline key verification example and HSM integration notes.
elaine: next steps: i'll draft the handoff doc with sections: overview, installer presets, preflight checklist, orchestrator design (dry-run, marker CRD, events), routing acceptance tests, packaging matrix, launch criteria, rollback runbook, troubleshooting.
bobby: i'll draft the manifest examples and plan output format.
mina: i'll own routing tests and dual-schema migration notes.
carlos: i'll write the packaging/offline bundle guide and MTU probe.
ops-bot: ACTION: created ticket RF-5002 "upgrade-orchestrator-handoff-doc" assigned to elaine, bobby, mina, carlos.
product-ops: will review draft for launch gating once elaine posts.
elaine: thanks all. please react with :eyes: when you glance at the draft.
